description: HostnFly offers this 48 m2 apartment in a quiet, leafy courtyard in the heart of Paris's 11th arrondissement, in the lively, central Popincourt Village district with its many shops and restaurants. The apartment is perfect for a stay in Paris with family or friends, and can accommodate up to 6 people.The spaceWarm and well-appointed, it comprises : - two bedrooms with double beds, - a mezzanine with 2 single beds, - a shower room, - a fully-equipped kitchen, - a lovely lounge area for relaxing after a day's outing. Facilities include a Nespresso coffee machine, dishwasher, microwave oven, washing machine/dryer, hairdryer, iron and WIFI. ⚠️ PLEASE NOTE – Read carefully before booking: The soundproofing of the accommodation is weak and the neighbors are sensitive. We thank you for keeping this in mind by being particularly mindful of noise levels, and we advise you to bring earplugs. Bed linen and towels are included in the cleaning fee. Located on the ground floor, the apartment is easily accessible for people with reduced mobility. Its strong point is its location: - in a pleasant, lively neighborhood, close to numerous shops (bakery, pastry shop, grocery store...), good restaurants and cafés, - in a central, authentically Parisian neighborhood served by 4 metro lines (3, 5, 8 and 9), - 15 minutes' walk from the historic Marais district. Places of interest close to the apartment (less than 15 minutes on foot): - the Marché des Enfants Rouges and Rue de Bretagne, a must-see, - the Musée National Picasso, - the Place de la Bastille and its Opera House, - the sublime Place des Vosges. Welcome to Paris!Guest accessYou will need to collect the keys in person when you check in. Bed linen and towels are included in the cleaning charge.
